description: How busy one day is in a hub of mygn.de (Hamburg, München, Oldenburg + Umland) and rundown.city (San Francisco): the number of events per category, how many are free, how many have a verified location, whether the day is quiet, normal or busy compared with the same kind of day (weekday or weekend) in the next 14 days (unknown for a day further out, where the listings are not complete yet) and top_curated, our editorial picks of the day (occurrence_id, title, starts_at; empty while nothing is rated). Events are counted once per day however many time slots they have. time_from (HH:MM, hub local time) counts only the events that start at or after that time, for 'tonight' (events without a known start time are then not counted, as in search_events; busyness still compares the whole day). Use it to answer 'is there a lot on this Saturday' before listing events with search_events.

date.description: The day in the hub's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD.
date.title: Date

hub.description: Hub (city): one of hamburg, muenchen, oldenburg, san-francisco. Case-insensitive; names and abbreviations are accepted too, for example 'Hamburg', 'HH', 'München', 'Munich', 'Muenchen', 'MUC', 'Oldenburg', 'OL', 'Oldenburg (Oldb)', 'SF', 'SFO', 'San Fran' or 'San Francisco'. Results report the slug.
hub.title: Hub

time_from.description: Count only events that start at or after this time of day, HH:MM in the hub's local time (24 hours), for example '17:00' for tonight. Events without a known start time (all_day, time_unknown) are then not counted; busyness still compares the whole day.
time_from.title: Time From

verbose.description: true adds the internal fields (curation score and flags, signals, series_kind, kind, long_running) that are left out by default.
verbose.title: Verbose
